messages:
kyle: Heads-up — hotfix for 1.9.4. Need expedited cutoff at 2pm PT (in ~2h). Minimal diffs only. I'm triaging merge list now. Reply with PR links or :thumbsup: if you can help.
jen: On it. Security flagged one token leak PR earlier — I'll confirm whether it should be reverted or blocked, want to keep this release minimal.
omar: I can take changelog + publish if we get green CI.
deploy-bot: release-scheduler: release/1.9.4-hotfix scheduled, post-cutoff deploy window +30m.
maria: tagging candidate PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3456, https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3460. Both small, 3460 needs a tiny test fix.
alex: +1 to minimal diffs. Can we avoid any model packaging/quant changes? those blow up CI.
jen: PR#3456 touches auth (small). PR#3470 is the leak revert — larger. avoid 3470 unless absolutely necessary.
omar: Plan: cherry-pick 3456 and 3460 to release branch, run quick smoke and e2e subset. Commands: 
```bash
git checkout release/1.9.4
git fetch origin
git cherry-pick -x abcdef1  # PR#3456
git cherry-pick -x bcdefa2  # PR#3460
./scripts/run-smoke.sh --fast
```
maria: Smoke passed locally for me on linux. :thumbsup:
alex: CI flaky on windows VM right now — for this patch can we require linux only? would avoid blocking.
jen: @siva can you give quick security review on 3456? low surface but want formal signoff. :eyes:
siva: Reviewed PR#3456, looks safe — no secret paths, approve. PR#3460 needs one header tweak, will sign off after patch.
omar: I'll prepare the cherry-pick PR to release/1.9.4 and request kyle for final merge. Will include minimal changelog notes.
kyle: Thanks — when merged, I (or @maria) will cut the tag and start rollout. Reminder: keep release notes short: 'hotfix: auth header trimming fix; small test fix'
maria: Tagging plan: `git tag -a v1.9.4-hotfix -m "hotfix: auth header trimming"` then `git push origin v1.9.4-hotfix`. I'll push after kyle merges.
deploy-bot: roll queue updated at 1789002600, awaiting tag push.
kyle: If anyone has last-minute concerns, shout now. Otherwise cutoff stands at 2pm PT.
jen: no further blockers from security.
omar: cherry-pick PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3482 (target: release/1.9.4) — requesting kyle for merge.
kyle: merging now, will watch CI and then tag.
maria: tagging and starting rollout. will paste tag + changelog here when done.
deploy-bot: roll started at 1789002800. Monitoring logs.
maria: Rollout complete — v1.9.4-hotfix live. CHANGELOG snippet: 'Fix: auth header trimming leading to token drop (hotfix). Tests: minor update to auth test.' :tada:
